description: Create, update, or delete a profile-owned rule under the active profile's .agents/rules directory. Frontmatter is written in oh-my-pi rule shape.
name: rule_manage

content.description: Full Markdown file (frontmatter + body). Mutually exclusive with metadata/body.

metadata.description: Frontmatter fields to merge: description, condition, astCondition, question, scope, globs, interruptMode, alwaysApply, agents, enabled.

overwrite.description: Allow create to replace an existing profile-owned rule (default false).

rule_id.description: Relative rule id without suffix, for example 'python/coding-style'.
